ja283:1.1: You wandered before destroying the best,
ja283:1.2: Having overcome the boar in this place,
ja283:1.3: Now alone, having departed, you brood,
ja283:1.4: Tiger, why is your strength not found today?”
ja283:2.1: Before these surely go from place to place,
ja283:2.2: Afraid, troubled, they sought out their own caves,
ja283:2.3: Now, having gathered, they dwell together,
ja283:2.4: Standing they are hard for me to conquer.
